intro: The Gentlemen, Interlock, and Kyber were the most active ransomware threat actors across 44 articles published between April 12 and May 4, 2026, with high-severity incidents dominating the coverage. Two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), were frequently cited alongside attacks impacting multiple sectors including healthcare, manufacturing, technology, and critical infrastructure. The ransomware activity was observed globally, with specific reports from the United States, Europe, North America, and Turkey.
